title: Structural Artefacts in Phishing URL Benchmarks: code and result tables
description:
Code, notebooks, result tables and figures for the paper "Structural Artefacts in Phishing URL Benchmarks: An Audit of Five Public Datasets and the Failure of Cross-Dataset Transfer".

The study audits five widely used public phishing URL benchmarks and shows that they encode collection conventions that inflate within-dataset results and can cause systematic cross-dataset prediction inversion, and that a simple pre-model audit exposes this. Version 2.0.0 is the journal revision: full-file provenance checks (Mendeley PhishURL derived from Kaggle Malicious; PhishStorm inside Kaggle Malicious with inverted labels), ablations, overlap-controlled transfer, operating points, TreeSHAP attribution, character CNN and DistilBERT models, a procedure-aligned benchmark built from Phishing.Database and Common Crawl, and the headline statistics and transfer heat map recomputed in one environment.

The two procedure-aligned sets used in the paper are included in datasets/aligned/. The third-party benchmark datasets are not redistributed; checksums.txt lists the SHA-256 of every file used.
